question: In the year 2017, which of the following countries hosted the Under-17 Football World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• India hosted the Under-17 Football World Cup in 2017, marking the first time the country hosted a FIFA event.

• The tournament took place from October 6 to October 28, 2017.

• Matches were held in six cities: New Delhi, Navi Mumbai, Goa, Kochi, Guwahati, and Kolkata.

• The final match was played at the Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata, which is one of the largest football stadiums in the world by capacity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **FIFA U-17 World Cup:**

• The FIFA U-17 World Cup is the world championship of football for male players under the age of 17 organized by Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA).

• It was first held in 1985 and is held every two years.

• This tournament serves as an important platform for young footballers to showcase their talent on an international stage.

• **Significance of the 2017 Tournament:**

• The 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup was significant for India as it marked the country's first major hosting of a FIFA tournament.

• Hosting this tournament was seen as a step forward in promoting football in India, a country where cricket has traditionally been the dominant sport.

• It was an opportunity to boost infrastructure and increase the popularity and development of football within the country.

• **Performance and Outcomes:**

• England won the 2017 FIFA U-17 World Cup, defeating Spain 5-2 in the final.

• This victory was notable as it was England's first title at this level, coming after their success at the U-20 World Cup earlier in the year.

• The tournament featured 24 teams from around the world, with a total of 52 matches played.
